name: The Beach Boys

whyMatters.en: California group that turned studio harmony and modular arrangement into rock's production frontier; Pet Sounds (1966) and Good Vibrations are the documented hinge.
whyMatters.zh: 加州组合：把录音室和声与模块化编曲推成摇滚制作前沿；Pet Sounds（1966）与 Good Vibrations 是有文献可查的铰链。

lyricQuotes: God only knows what I'd be without you
Wouldn't it be nice if we were older

shortBio.en: Brian Wilson studio pop; Pet Sounds and Good Vibrations are the modular peak.
shortBio.zh: Brian Wilson 录音室流行；Pet Sounds 与 Good Vibrations 是模块化高峰。

body.en:
Formed 1961 in California. Early surf hits precede the studio peak: Pet Sounds and the Smile sessions treated the studio as instrument—theremin, bicycle bells, stacked vocals, sectional recording.

Good Vibrations (1966) is the essential track. Documented influence on Beatles' late-60s studio work and later indie psych is the measure, not sales metaphor.
body.zh:
1961 年于加州组建。早期冲浪热单之后是录音室高峰：Pet Sounds 与 Smile 录音把录音室当乐器——theremin、自行车铃、堆叠人声、分段录音。

Good Vibrations（1966）是必听曲。对 Beatles 60 年代末录音室工作与后来 indie 迷幻的可查影响，才是尺度，而非销量比喻。

note.en: Early surf-rock; Chuck Berry riff rewrite on stack vocals.
note.zh: 早期 surf-rock；Chuck Berry riff 改写加堆叠人声。

note.en: Pet Sounds; layered vocals and French horn in modular studio take.
note.zh: Pet Sounds；多层人声与法国号，模块化录音室 take。

note.en: Modular single; theremin hook and sectional edits as production method.
note.zh: 模块化单曲；theremin hook 与分段剪辑作为制作方法。

title.en: Studio as instrument on Pet Sounds

body.en:
Pet Sounds (1966) moves from surf singles to modular arrangement: Wouldn't It Be Nice, God Only Knows, stacked Wilson vocals, session players beside the band.

Good Vibrations assembles sections recorded across studios—theremin lead, cello, vocal overlays. Brian Wilson's production is the cited object.
body.zh:
Pet Sounds（1966）从 surf 单曲转向模块化编曲：Wouldn't It Be Nice、God Only Knows、Wilson 堆叠人声、乐队外的 session 乐手。

Good Vibrations 跨录音室组装段落——theremin 主奏、大提琴、人声叠层。Brian Wilson 的制作是被引对象。

body.en:
Brian, Carl, and Dennis Wilson are the core; Mike Love and Al Jardine share lead vocals on tour and record. Brian retreats from live stage after 1964; studio peak is 1965–67.

Smile sessions fracture the timeline; Pet Sounds and Good Vibrations remain the citation peak before Brian's withdrawal.
body.zh:
Brian、Carl、Dennis Wilson 是核心；Mike Love 与 Al Jardine 分担巡演与录音主唱。Brian 1964 后退出现场；录音室峰值在 1965–67。

Smile 录音撕裂时间线；Pet Sounds 与 Good Vibrations 仍是 Brian 退出前的引用峰值。

title.zh: 60 年代末摇滚里的和声制作

body.en:
The Beatles' Revolver and Sgt. Pepper sessions document cross-influence with Pet Sounds. Pink Floyd's studio psych inherits the sectional method.

Chuck Berry riffs sit in early surf singles; the durable export is stacked vocal arrangement and modular editing—not beach imagery alone.
body.zh:
Beatles 的 Revolver 与 Sgt. Pepper 录音室文献记录与 Pet Sounds 的交叉影响。Pink Floyd 录音室 psych 继承分段方法。

Chuck Berry riff 在早期 surf 单曲里； durable 输出是堆叠和声编排与模块化剪辑——不只海滩意象。

body.en: Early surf-rock; Chuck Berry riff rewrite on stack vocals.
body.zh: 早期 surf-rock；Chuck Berry riff 改写加堆叠人声。
